verdict.rationale: Oracle's docs demonstrate a consistent structural pattern (CLI, SDK, REST API concepts pages) applied across varied services—compute, identity, billing, Terraform, Data Science, Generative AI—suggesting reference docs extend beyond flagship compute/storage into newer AI and platform services. However, the evidence pack shows no explicit API reference (e.g., no discoverable OpenAPI spec via probes) and no independent/developer corroboration confirming reference-doc consistency or completeness across the full service catalog. missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of consistency, evidence of a full API reference/OpenAPI catalog, coverage confirmation for lesser-used or niche services.
